findings.description: Non-identical roadmap items sharing one item_id fail closed during roadmap loading with ValueError('duplicate item ids: ...') which maps to diagnostic code 'roadmap_invalid' with stale=true. The check is implemented via a linear-time set scan during _read_roadmap in skills/roadmap-runtime/scripts/resolve_readiness.py:98-107 and verified by test_duplicate_item_ids_make_a_roadmap_invalid in skills/tests/roadmap-runtime/test_readiness.py:328-344.
findings.resolution: Accept linear-time semantic duplicate item check and fail-closed roadmap_invalid handling.

findings.description: The CLI main() entrypoint in skills/roadmap-runtime/scripts/resolve_readiness.py:419-425 writes json-serialized readiness results with a trailing newline to sys.stdout and returns exit code 2 when hard-invalid input is present. Verified by direct CLI integration test test_cli_emits_json_and_returns_nonzero_for_invalid_input in skills/tests/roadmap-runtime/test_readiness.py:345-357.
findings.resolution: Accept CLI boundary error code and newline-terminated JSON emission.

findings.description: The admission rule _get_ready_items is defined exactly once in skills/roadmap-runtime/scripts/readiness.py:13-40 and imported by both required consumers (autopilot-roadmap orchestrator.py and resolve_readiness.py). Enforced by AST test in test_readiness.py.
findings.resolution: Accept single-definition architecture and AST enforcement.

findings.description: Valid checkpoints authoritatively govern terminal state over roadmap status fields. Soft status lag emits roadmap_checkpoint_divergence with stale=true without withholding workspace items or completion refs. Hard-invalid checkpoints fail closed with exit code 2 and withhold affected ready items and external completion refs.
findings.resolution: Accept checkpoint authority model, divergence diagnostic reporting, and fail-closed error handling.

findings.description: Workspaces lacking a checkpoint file default to roadmap definition status as the valid never-started baseline and report checkpoint_absent with stale=false.

Typed external dependencies (external_depends_on) require effective completion in referenced workspaces before unblocking. Supersession, failed items, and local dependency checks match spec rules, and final flat ready entries are globally sorted by (priority, roadmap_id, item_id).
findings.resolution: Accept dependency evaluation rules and global ranking.

findings.description: SHA-256 source_fingerprint is derived from a canonical sorted projection of roadmaps and checkpoints, ignoring timestamps, mtimes, learnings, handoffs, and queue state. Unchanged inputs produce byte-identical JSON stdout with a trailing newline.
findings.resolution: Accept content-derived fingerprint determinism and advisory artifact isolation.

findings.description: Supervisor ready_across_roadmaps groups canonical resolver output by roadmap_id, maintaining backward compatibility for existing callers. Models are loaded via explicit path and unique module names to avoid sys.modules collisions regardless of test collection order.
findings.resolution: Accept supervisor compatibility wrapper and collision-proof module loading.

findings.description: Unit and integration tests in skills/tests/roadmap-runtime/ pass completely (144 focused tests, 14 readiness tests passing). Ruff linter checks pass with zero warnings. Code coverage includes single definition AST assertions, soft divergence, hard invalid fail-closed behavior, duplicate item ID validation, CLI boundary exit code 2 and stdout formatting.
findings.resolution: Accept test suite coverage and verification results.

findings.description: The readiness resolver CLI is completely read-only, performs no file writes or network calls, resolves paths relative to repo_root safely, and introduces no contract drift or out-of-scope mutations.
findings.resolution: Accept read-only security boundary and path safety.
